title: Alleged repeated withdrawal
report_body: Complete relevant function: mapping(address=>uint) balances; function withdraw() external { uint amount=balances[msg.sender]; require(amount>0); balances[msg.sender]=0; (bool ok,)=msg.sender.call{value:amount}(""); require(ok); } All balance writes are shown. The report claims a callback withdraws the same deposit twice. Local callback trace: second withdraw reads zero and reverts; no second transfer occurs. No other flaw or loss demonstrated. Is the claimed High repeated-withdrawal proposal supported?
